hero.headline: Tax, GST and company compliance for your business
hero.subtext: Registrations, returns, accounts and ROC filings for businesses and individuals in Kothanur and north-east Bengaluru. Visit our office or consult us by phone and WhatsApp.
hero.imageAlt: Professionals in a meeting in a modern office

about.title: A local practice that keeps your compliance in order
about.text: Jagadev Associates LLP works with shop owners, startups, professionals and salaried individuals across Kothanur and north-east Bengaluru. We handle the paperwork, explain it in plain language, and keep track of what is due next.
points: One office for registrations, returns and filings
Documents checked before anything is filed
In-person visits or fully remote service
Your data handled in line with the DPDP Act

servicesIntro.title: Our services
servicesIntro.text: Five service areas, one office. Each page lists what is included, the documents to bring and how the work is done.

counters.label: Days a week the office is open

items.title: Personal attention
items.text: You deal directly with the people doing your work, not a call centre.

items.title: Checked before filing
items.text: Every document is reviewed before it goes to a government portal.

items.title: On time
items.text: We track your due dates so nothing is left to the last day.

items.title: Remote or in person
items.text: Visit the office or work with us entirely by phone and WhatsApp.

items.title: Plain-language advice
items.text: We explain what is required and why, before any work starts.

items.title: Careful with your data
items.text: Your documents are used only for your work and stored securely.

process.title: How we work
process.text: A clear, simple process, whether you visit us or consult remotely.

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.text: Call, WhatsApp or visit. We confirm the scope of work and the documents required.

steps.title: Share your documents
steps.text: Bring them to the office or send them securely. We check them before anything is filed.

steps.title: We prepare and file
steps.text: Registrations, returns and filings are prepared and submitted on the official portals.

steps.title: You get confirmation
steps.text: You receive the acknowledgement or certificate, and we note what is due next.

office.title: Visit our office in Kothanur
office.text: Our office is on Maha Yogi Vemanna Reddy Road in Bhoo Vaibhava Layout. Walk in during office hours, or call ahead and we will keep your file ready.
office.imageAlt: Bright open office with desks and computers

cta.title: Have a filing coming up? Talk to us today.
cta.text: Call, WhatsApp or walk in. We will tell you exactly what is needed.
